subject: Learning Methods
title: Note-Taking Apps Compared
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Note-Taking Apps Compared.

hook.text: Notion, Obsidian, Roam, and Apple Notes each attract loyal fans who swear their tool is the best for all purposes.

buildup.text: Each app optimizes for different needs: Notion for databases, Obsidian for linking, Roam for daily notes, Apple Notes.

discovery.text: The best app is the one that fits your workflow with the least friction... and the one you will actually open daily.

twist.text: App-hopping is a common trap. Migrating notes wastes hours that could have been spent learning. Pick one and commit.

climax.text: Try a tool for two weeks. If you open it naturally, keep it. If not, switch once. Then stop switching.

punchline.text: The tool matters less than the habit. Pick one and stay.

quiz.question: What is the biggest risk when choosing a note-taking app?
options: App-hopping and repeatedly migrating notes instead of learning
Using an app that is too expensive
